name: Streamline Moderne product
region: United States, with Britain and France
summary: Smooth, rounded objects that look fast: toasters, radios, lamps and chairs in chrome, aluminium, Bakelite and enamel, with long horizontal lines and speed stripes, made in mass series.

philosophy.core_thesis: A mass-made object should look as if it moves through air: a smooth shell, round corners and long lines show progress and sell.
design_principles: Round each outside corner with a radius of 20 to 60 mm; no sharp corner shows on the body.
Draw long horizontal lines: two or three speed stripes, grooves or bands that run the full length of the object.
Wrap the moving parts in one smooth shell of pressed steel, cast aluminium or moulded Bakelite.
Use chrome, polished aluminium and white or cream enamel; they reflect the light and look clean.
Taper the form at the rear in a teardrop, so that the outline cuts the air.
Hide the joints and the fasteners under the shell; a seam is a single line or a chrome band.
Design for mass production: one die or one mould makes thousands of the same shell.
anti_patterns: Visible bolts, rivets and raw welds
Dark, heavy timber and a hand-made look
Vertical emphasis with a tall, narrow form

form.geometry: The ellipse, the teardrop, the long cylinder and the rounded box, with horizontal grooves and bands.
form.silhouette: A low, long, rounded outline that is higher at the front and tapers to the rear, like a train, a ship or an aircraft.
form.edges: Large, continuous radii of 20 to 60 mm on all outside corners; a fillet of 5 to 10 mm along each seam.
form.proportion: The length is 1.5 to 3 times the height; a radio case is about 35 cm wide and 20 cm high; a stripe is 5 to 10 mm wide.
form.ornament: Two to five parallel speed stripes, a chrome band or a fin; they cover 5 to 15% of the surface and run along the length.
rules: No outside corner has a radius under 15 mm.
Each object has 2 to 5 parallel horizontal lines or grooves.
The body is one smooth shell with no visible fastener.
The length of the object is at least 1.5 times its height.
Chrome or polished aluminium covers 20 to 40% of the surface; the rest is enamel, Bakelite or glass.

materials.rule: Bright metal and enamel make about 60% of the visible surface; Bakelite, laminate and glass are smooth, and textile is plain.

finish.gloss: 80–100 GU on chrome and enamel; 40–70 GU on brushed aluminium
finish.patina: The style wants a new, smooth shine; a pit, a scratch or a rust spot is out of character.

hardware.section: Tube 20–32 mm, handles 15–25 mm, trim bands 5–10 mm wide
hardware.joints: A single chrome band or a flush seam; fasteners are hidden under the shell or under a cap.
hardware.handles: A round knob or a bar in Bakelite or chrome, set flush with the shell, with a section of 15 to 25 mm.
hardware.switches_and_taps: A large round Bakelite dial or a lever set in the shell; a tap with a smooth, rounded body and a chrome lever.

palette.strategy: Clean, light colour with bright metal: cream, white and pale green or blue, with chrome and one red or black stripe.

manufacture.scale: Mass series of tens of thousands, made by large firms for the home, the shop and the transport industry.
manufacture.signs: A smooth parting line along a rounded seam, a die-pressed groove, a chrome band at the join and a mould mark on the back.

positive: pale green and sky blue enamel

emotion.target_response: Light, hopeful speed: the viewer sees a clean, bright object that belongs to the future.

use_cases: kitchen objects and lighting for a retro-modern interior
a brief for a reissued appliance
a still life of chrome and enamel objects
hardware schedules for a diner or a station
avoid_when: The room needs hand-made, rough or antique objects.
The brief asks for visible fasteners or raw metal.

modifiers.how: Replace the stripes with stepped tiers and a fan, and use ebony, mirror and gilt.
Drop the round shell and the stripes; use plain solids and show the joints.
Keep the round shell, but use moulded plastic in a saturated colour.

era_blend.note: A contemporary object with the same shell, radius and stripe keeps the style.
